cases.name: TestUint 18446744073709551614
cases.note: The source decodes an unsigned value; polytini values are signed, so the expected value is the zigzag-decoded source value. Uses 64-bit integers. polytini works with exact Numbers and throws overflow past 2^53; the source value is kept in expected (as the nearest double).

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: empty string (DecodeCoords)
cases.note: DecodeUint returns ErrEmpty, DecodeCoords returns no points and no error. polytini decode works on coordinates.

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: ">"
cases.note: ErrInvalidByte

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: byte 0x80
cases.note: ErrInvalidByte (the source uses the byte 0x80; here it is the character U+0080).

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: "_"
cases.note: ErrUnterminatedSequence

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: 12 x "~"
cases.note: The source returns ErrUnterminatedSequence; polytini sees the value pass 2^53 at index 10 first.

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: 12 x "~" then ">"
cases.note: The source returns ErrInvalidByte; polytini throws overflow at index 10 first.

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: 12 x "~" then "O"
cases.note: ErrOverflow

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: 12 x "~" then "_"
cases.note: ErrOverflow

cases.name: TestDecodeErrors: 12 x "~" then 0x80
cases.note: The source returns ErrInvalidByte; polytini throws overflow at index 10 first.
